name: ABT-925
summary: ABT-925, also known as A-437203 or as LU-201640, is a selective dopamine D3 receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed. It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: ABT-925, also known as A-437203 or as LU-201640, is a selective dopamine D3 receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed. It showed little activity in classical tests of antipsychotic-like activity in rodents, for instance inhibition of methamphetamine-induced hyperlocomotion and inhibition of apomorphine-induced climbing behavior.

uses.text: ABT-925, also known as A-437203 or as LU-201640, is a selective dopamine D3 receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia but was never marketed. The occupancy of the dopamine D3 receptor by ABT-925 has been studied in humans. It was under development by Abbott Laboratories.
